# PSP WebAssembly encryption component

`web/src/vendor/psp-encryption.js` and `psp-encryption.wasm` are the v1.0.0
release of [euan-forrester/psp-encryption-webassembly](https://github.com/euan-forrester/psp-encryption-webassembly),
from commit `350b21d61e2dbbffc2bd3e7ae4834ccae2646f1c`.

The corresponding source, build instructions, and GPL-3.0 license are in
`third_party/psp-encryption-webassembly`. The binary files are unmodified.
